## Project Structure

```
├── review.qmd                  # Main review manuscript
├── protocol/
│   └── review-protocol.qmd     # Detailed protocol
├── search-strategy/

├── screening/

├── data-extraction/
│   ├── extraction-form.qmd     # Data extraction template
│   ├── extracted-data.csv      # Main data extraction
│   └── quality-assessment.csv  # Quality/risk of bias assessment
├── analysis/
│   ├── descriptive-analysis.R  # Study characteristics
│   ├── meta-analysis.R         # Quantitative synthesis (if applicable)
│   └── narrative-synthesis.R   # Qualitative synthesis
├── figures/
│   ├── prisma-flowchart.png    # PRISMA flow diagram
│   ├── study-characteristics/  # Descriptive figures
│   └── forest-plots/          # Meta-analysis plots (if applicable)
└── supplementary/
    ├── excluded-studies.csv    # Studies excluded at full-text
    ├── search-results/         # Raw database search results
    └── additional-materials/   # Supporting documents
```

## Running the Review

### Complete Review Build
```bash
# Generate main review document
quarto render review.qmd

# Build all supplementary materials
quarto render protocol/review-protocol.qmd
quarto render search-strategy/search-terms.qmd
```

### Analysis Pipeline
```bash
# Run analysis scripts
Rscript analysis/descriptive-analysis.R
Rscript analysis/narrative-synthesis.R

# Meta-analysis (if applicable)
Rscript analysis/meta-analysis.R
```
